description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the AbstractHandler class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the handling of complex data associated with Obs objects, including file naming conventions and persistence behavior.

classes.name: AbstractHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AbstractHandler, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, testing complex data save behavior and filename handling.

methods.name: initializeContext
methods.description: Sets up the test context, initializes the handler, and configures the global property for complex obs directory.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldNeverOverwritePreviousFiles
methods.description: Tests that saving Obs objects with complex data does not overwrite previous files, verifying data consistency.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldPreserveTitleWithoutExtension
methods.description: Ensures that the filename saved for complex data preserves the title without the file extension.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldCorrectlySaveFileWithoutTitle
methods.description: Verifies that when the complex data has a null title, the filename and key are correctly saved.
